scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical via a signed quadratic numerator and explicit stable drift. A packaged standalone numerical checker supports, but does not replace, the infinite-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact within two specified stationary linear-noise Gaussian spectra of the open Michaelis–Menten reaction. Not an exact chemical master equation result or a statement about the physical validity of high-frequency quasi-steady-state extrapolation; historical priority provisional.
title: A unique frequency reversal in heuristic Michaelis–Menten substrate-noise spectra
